args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays, affecting fastjson <2.9.4. Bump to 2.9.4 which contains the fix.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in requirements.txt.

## Security
Fixes [CVE-2026-31337](high) — unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays (fastjson < 2.9.4 affected). Version 2.9.4 is the patched 2.x release; this stays on the 2.x line to avoid a major-version bump.

## Testing
CI run on this branch: `ci-0001` — passed.
